top_module.name: temp_monitor_digital
top_module.description: Top-level temperature monitor digital controller and register-mapped interface. This module integrates MMIO register decode, control/status flops, sample request generation, temperature filtering, threshold compare, sticky alert/IRQ logic, and readback muxing.
top_module.functionality: Top-level integrated RTL contracts for a mixed-signal temperature monitor. It accepts register write/read transactions, generates one-cycle control pulses from register writes, issues sample_req pulses from explicit sample-start requests and from periodic enabled operation, captures adc_code on adc_valid, computes a two-sample moving average filtered temperature code, updates the latest temperature register, increments completed sample count, compares filtered temperature against THRESHOLD, and latches alert and sample-done sticky state and IRQ status. The module also produces alert_irq when IRQ is enabled and any IRQ status bit is latched. Register readback returns CONTROL, STATUS, THRESHOLD, LATEST_TEMP, SAMPLE_COUNT, IRQ_STATUS, and IRQ_CLEAR semantics as specified.
responsibilities: Decode CONTROL, THRESHOLD, STATUS, LATEST_TEMP, SAMPLE_COUNT, IRQ_STATUS, and IRQ_CLEAR register behavior.
Generate one-cycle pulses for SAMPLE_START, ALERT_CLEAR, and IRQ_CLEAR bits.
Maintain stored ENABLE and IRQ_ENABLE control state.
Maintain sticky STATUS and IRQ status bits.
Produce sample_req pulses for explicit sample requests and periodic enabled sampling.
Capture ADC samples, filter them, update latest_temp, and increment sample_count.
Compare latest_temp against threshold_code and latch alert state when above threshold.
Assert alert_irq only when IRQ_ENABLE is set and at least one IRQ status bit is latched.
Provide zero-extended readback values for read-only registers and upper bits of partial-width fields.
Preserve architectural ownership of explicit internal state signals.
top_module.reset_behavior: On reset_n deassertion, clear CONTROL.ENABLE, CONTROL.IRQ_ENABLE, all pulse outputs, STATUS.sample_done, STATUS.alert_pending, STATUS.adc_valid_seen, STATUS.busy, IRQ status bits, alert_status, latest_temp, sample_count, threshold_code_reg, rd_data, sample_req, alert_irq, temp_code, threshold_code, and all internal sticky state to zero.
behavior_rules: CONTROL bit 0 stores ENABLE.
CONTROL bit 1 is a write pulse; writing 1 generates a one-cycle sample request and does not store the bit.
CONTROL bit 2 stores IRQ_ENABLE.
CONTROL bit 3 is a write pulse; writing 1 generates an alert clear action and does not store the bit.
STATUS bit 0 is sticky sample_done until cleared by IRQ_CLEAR bit 1.
STATUS bit 1 is sticky alert_pending until cleared by ALERT_CLEAR or IRQ_CLEAR bit 0.
STATUS bit 2 is sticky adc_valid_seen after the first adc_valid until reset.
STATUS bit 3 busy is high while a requested sample is pending.
THRESHOLD stores threshold_code_reg in bits [11:0] and reads upper bits as zero.
LATEST_TEMP readback is latest_temp in bits [11:0] with upper bits zero.
SAMPLE_COUNT is read-only and increments on each completed adc_valid sample.
IRQ_STATUS bit 0 latches alert and bit 1 latches sample_done until cleared by IRQ_CLEAR.
alert_irq = CONTROL.IRQ_ENABLE AND (IRQ_STATUS.alert OR IRQ_STATUS.sample_done).
A sample request pulse may be generated immediately from CONTROL.SAMPLE_START and periodically when CONTROL.ENABLE is asserted, using a synthesizable internal schedule.

On adc_valid, the design captures adc_code, updates the two-sample moving average result to latest_temp/temp_code, increments sample_count, sets STATUS.sample_done and IRQ_STATUS.sample_done, sets STATUS.adc_valid_seen, and compares the filtered temp_code against threshold_code_reg.
When filtered temp_code is above threshold_code_reg, alert_status, STATUS.alert_pending, and IRQ_STATUS.alert are latched.

ALERT_CLEAR clears alert_status and STATUS.alert_pending, and may also clear IRQ_STATUS.alert only if implemented through the specified alert-clear behavior, but it must not affect sample_count, threshold_code_reg, or latest_temp.
IRQ_CLEAR bit 0 clears IRQ_STATUS.alert and alert_status.
IRQ_CLEAR bit 1 clears IRQ_STATUS.sample_done and STATUS.sample_done.
Writes to non-reserved read-only locations must not alter state beyond the specified side effects.
Unread or unmapped addresses return zero on rd_data unless mapped otherwise by the specified register map.

modules.name: temp_monitor_digital_regfile
modules.description: Register decode, storage, readback mux, and pulse generation for the temperature monitor MMIO map.
modules.functionality: Implements the MMIO-visible register bank. It stores CONTROL.ENABLE, CONTROL.IRQ_ENABLE, threshold_code_reg, and produces one-cycle pulses for SAMPLE_START, ALERT_CLEAR, and IRQ_CLEAR bits. It also muxes read data for CONTROL, STATUS, THRESHOLD, LATEST_TEMP, SAMPLE_COUNT, IRQ_STATUS, and IRQ_CLEAR with all unspecified upper bits returning zero.
responsibilities: Decode wr_addr and rd_addr.
Store CONTROL.ENABLE and CONTROL.IRQ_ENABLE.
Emit sample-start, alert-clear, and IRQ-clear pulses from writes.
Store threshold_code_reg from THRESHOLD writes.
Assemble STATUS readback from sticky status inputs and internal decode.
Assemble read-only status and counter readback values with zero extension.
Present a write-one-to-clear compatible view of IRQ_CLEAR.
Drive the architectural threshold_code_reg output used by the datapath/comparator.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset clears stored CONTROL bits, threshold_code_reg, write-pulse outputs, and rd_data to zero.
behavior_rules: CONTROL bit 0 is a stored level bit.
CONTROL bit 1 is an un-stored write pulse that returns zero on readback.
CONTROL bit 2 is a stored IRQ enable bit.
CONTROL bit 3 is an un-stored write pulse that returns zero on readback.
STATUS is read-only and reflects its input sticky bits.
THRESHOLD[11:0] reads/writes threshold_code_reg and upper bits read as zero.
LATEST_TEMP[11:0] returns latest_temp and upper bits are zero.
SAMPLE_COUNT is read-only and reflects the input counter.
IRQ_STATUS readback reflects the input sticky IRQ bits.
IRQ_CLEAR readback is zero; writes generate clear pulses for supported bits only.
Any unmapped read returns zero.
One-cycle pulses must not self-stretch.

modules.name: temp_monitor_digital_sample_ctrl
modules.description: Sampling control, request pulse generation, ADC sample capture/processing, two-sample moving average filtering, threshold comparison, sticky status and IRQ latching.
modules.functionality: Maintains the dynamic temperature-monitor datapath and sticky status/IRQ state. It emits sample_req pulses from explicit sample-start requests and periodic enabled sampling, captures adc_code when adc_valid arrives, computes a simple two-sample moving average, updates latest_temp and temp_code, increments sample_count, asserts compare_alert when filtered temperature exceeds threshold_code_reg, and latches alert_status, STATUS.alert_pending, STATUS.sample_done, STATUS.adc_valid_seen, IRQ_STATUS.alert, and IRQ_STATUS.sample_done as specified. It also generates alert_irq from IRQ_ENABLE and latched IRQ status.
responsibilities: Generate explicit one-cycle sample_req pulses.
Generate deterministic periodic sample_req pulses while enabled.
Track a pending-busy condition while a request awaits adc_valid.
Capture adc_code on adc_valid.
Filter using a two-sample moving average and present the resulting temp_code/latest_temp.
Compare filtered temperature against threshold_code_reg.
Latch alert and sample-done sticky state.
Clear only the specified sticky bits on ALERT_CLEAR and IRQ_CLEAR inputs.
Maintain sample_count as a completed-sample counter.
Drive alert_irq according to IRQ enable and latched IRQ status.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset clears all sticky state, internal sample history, busy indication, sample request pulse state, alert_irq, alert_status, compare_alert, sample_done_pulse, sample_count, latest_temp, temp_code, and IRQ/status flags to zero.
behavior_rules: sample_req is asserted for one cycle on an explicit start request and may also assert periodically when enabled.
status_busy is high while a requested sample is pending adc_valid.
On adc_valid, the module must capture the incoming ADC code and update the filtered temperature result.
The two-sample moving average must be implemented in synthesizable RTL without combinational loops.
sample_count increments exactly once per completed adc_valid sample.
status_sample_done and irq_status_sample_done latch on each completed sample until cleared by IRQ_CLEAR bit 1.
status_alert_pending and irq_status_alert latch when filtered temperature exceeds threshold_code_reg until cleared by ALERT_CLEAR or IRQ_CLEAR bit 0 as specified.
status_adc_valid_seen becomes sticky after the first adc_valid and remains high until reset.
alert_irq must be a pure function of control_irq_enable and latched IRQ status bits.
compare_alert is an explicit internal comparator output that reflects the threshold exceed condition from the filtered temp_code.
No sticky clear operation may modify latest_temp, threshold_code_reg, or sample_count.
The datapath must be deterministic for repeated adc_valid assertions and repeated sample requests.
All outputs must be registered or safely derived to maintain synthesizability.

top_level_connections.description: Distribute the single synchronous clock to register and datapath/control logic.
Fan out the active-low synchronous reset to all submodules.
Register write strobe enters the register file only.
Write address enters the register file only.
Write data enters the register file only.
Register read strobe enters the register file only.
Read address enters the register file only.
ADC conversion code is consumed by the sample control/datapath.
ADC valid pulse is consumed by the sample control/datapath.
Read data returned from the register file drives the top-level read data output.
Sample request output is driven by the sample control block.
Alert interrupt output is driven by the sample control block.
Latest filtered temperature code is driven by the sample control block.
Threshold code output reflects the stored threshold register value.
Alert status output is driven by the sticky alert state in the sample control block.

inter_module_signals.name: control_enable
inter_module_signals.description: Stored CONTROL.ENABLE bit from register file to sample controller.

inter_module_signals.name: control_sample_start_pulse
inter_module_signals.description: One-cycle SAMPLE_START write pulse from register file to sample controller.

inter_module_signals.name: control_irq_enable
inter_module_signals.description: Stored CONTROL.IRQ_ENABLE bit from register file to sample controller.

inter_module_signals.name: control_alert_clear_pulse
inter_module_signals.description: CONTROL.ALERT_CLEAR write pulse routed to sticky alert clear logic.

inter_module_signals.name: irq_clear_alert_pulse
inter_module_signals.description: IRQ_CLEAR bit 0 pulse routed to alert clear logic.

inter_module_signals.name: irq_clear_sample_done_pulse
inter_module_signals.description: IRQ_CLEAR bit 1 pulse routed to sample-done clear logic.

inter_module_signals.name: threshold_code_reg
inter_module_signals.description: Stored threshold register value used by the comparator and readback.

inter_module_signals.name: status_sample_done
inter_module_signals.description: Sticky sample_done status returned by the register file.

inter_module_signals.name: status_alert_pending
inter_module_signals.description: Sticky alert_pending status returned by the register file.

inter_module_signals.name: status_adc_valid_seen
inter_module_signals.description: Sticky adc_valid_seen status returned by the register file.

inter_module_signals.name: status_busy
inter_module_signals.description: Busy status returned by the register file.

inter_module_signals.name: irq_status_alert
inter_module_signals.description: Latched alert IRQ status returned by the register file.

inter_module_signals.name: irq_status_sample_done
inter_module_signals.description: Latched sample-done IRQ status returned by the register file.

inter_module_signals.name: latest_temp
inter_module_signals.description: Latest filtered temperature code for register readback.

inter_module_signals.name: sample_count
inter_module_signals.description: Completed sample count for register readback.

fields.name: SAMPLE_START
fields.description: Write-one pulse requesting one conversion; reads back as 0.

fields.name: ALERT_CLEAR
fields.description: Write-one pulse that clears alert_status and STATUS.alert_pending; reads back as 0.

fields.name: sample_done
fields.description: Sticky after any completed adc_valid sample until cleared by IRQ_CLEAR bit 1.

fields.name: alert_pending
fields.description: Mirrors latched alert_status until ALERT_CLEAR or IRQ_CLEAR bit 0 is written.

fields.name: adc_valid_seen
fields.description: Sticky after the first adc_valid sample until reset.

fields.name: busy
fields.description: High while a requested sample is pending.

fields.name: sample_done
fields.description: Sticky interrupt status for sample done.
